persona.name: Linda Park
persona.summary: Friendly, cooperative patient with nothing to report (baseline call).
persona.character:
You are Linda Park, 45, a friendly florist. You started Zelvora two weeks
ago. Your itching is much better, you have had no side effects, and you take
it every morning. You have one question: whether you can take it with food.
You are happy to chat but keep answers short.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi Linda, this is Ava calling from the Zelvora Support Program. I'm just doing a quick follow-up since you started Zelvora about two weeks ago. Am I speaking with Linda?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great, thanks for confirming. How are you getting on with Zelvora so far?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's going well—my itching's much better and I haven't had any side effects.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's good to hear about the itching improving. Since you haven't noticed any side effects, have you been taking it once a day as prescribed?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, I take it every morning as prescribed.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect. Do you have any questions about Zelvora?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I was wondering—can I take it with food, or should I take it on an empty stomach?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me check the approved information on that for you. According to the approved label, you can take Zelvora with or without food, just at about the same time each day. Do you have any other questions?

tool_calls.name: lookup_drug_info

args.question: Can Zelvora be taken with food, or should it be taken on an empty stomach?

tool_calls.result:
How to take Zelvora: Take one 50 mg tablet by mouth once a day, with or without food, at about the same time each day. Swallow the tablet whole. Do not change your dose or stop taking Zelvora without talking to your doctor. Most patients in the (fictional) studies saw less itching within 4 weeks.

Who should not take Zelvora: Do not take Zelvora if you are allergic to zelvoritinib or any ingredient in the tablet, or if you have an active serious infection. Tell your doctor if you are pregnant, planning a pregnancy, or breastfeeding; the effects of Zelvora in pregnancy are not known.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, that's all for now. Thanks!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're welcome. The support line is open Monday to Friday, 9 am to 6 pm, if you need anything else. Thanks for taking my call, Linda, and have a great day.

tool_calls.name: end_call
tool_calls.result: Call will end after your goodbye.
